theorem.name: DECLARED_UNIVERSAL_E6_EXACT_CARRIER_EXISTS_IFF_P_EQUALS_NP_V1
theorem.statement: For the declared authoritative E6 signed-Huang connected source class and the exact carrier contract frozen in E7, a universal polynomial exact carrier exists if and only if P=NP.

proof: E6 gives a polynomial-time source construction mapping every finite 3-CNF Phi to an authoritative connected P7-free source state P(Phi).
E6 proves exact equivalence: P(Phi) is color-extendable iff Phi is satisfiable.
A universal E7 carrier decides base feasibility of every such P(Phi) in polynomial time.
Therefore arbitrary 3-SAT is decidable in polynomial time.
Assume P=NP. Then 3-SAT has a polynomial-time decision algorithm.

The E6 state already has a polynomial-size exact signed-factor description: optional equality variables e_i, signed 3-clause factors, constant-size local C7 relation/witness data, fixed seed/X0 metadata, and independent reconstruction receipts.
Base feasibility is decided by translating the current exact factor state to polynomial-size 3-CNF over equality bits and calling the assumed polynomial 3-SAT algorithm.

An R1 restriction or R2 restriction changes only polynomially many local unary/boundary conditions; the affected constant-size local factor tables can be recomputed and encoded by polynomial-size CNF using constant-size auxiliary variables if needed.
A successful update persists those restrictions and runs the already sealed deterministic B2B1 canonical bookkeeping; the factor representation remains polynomial in the current graph/state size.

To reconstruct a satisfying Boolean equality assignment, apply standard SAT self-reduction: fix equality variables one at a time and retain a value whose residual formula is satisfiable. This uses O(n) polynomial-time SAT calls.
For each equality bit e_i, choose a compatible pair state (x_i,d_i); set ~x_i to the opposite binary color.
For each clause/local factor, use its stored constant-size witness indexed by the realized boundary tuple.
Combine with frozen seed/X0 colors and independent deleted-component receipts to reconstruct a full coloring.
direction_P_equals_NP_implies_carrier.carrier_size: Polynomial: store the source graph/factor incidence, constant-size domain/factor tables, fixed statuses/colors, and receipt pointers.
direction_P_equals_NP_implies_carrier.query_update_reconstruct: Polynomial under the conditional P=NP assumption.

exact_scope.covered: The unrestricted connected E6 signed-Huang source class realizing arbitrary signed 3-CNF.
exact_scope.not_extended_to: All source-valid P7-free hard states outside E6 unless separately reduced to this carrier contract.
exact_scope.carrier_contract: base feasibility + exact R1/R2 + successful update/canonical bookkeeping + reconstruction.

interpretation.frontier: The unrestricted signed-Huang universal-carrier problem is exactly P-vs-NP scale under the declared contract.
interpretation.routine_structural_search: EXHAUSTED_FOR_THIS_BRANCH unless an additional source restriction is imposed.
interpretation.direct_success: A constructive unconditional polynomial carrier here would constitute a proof that P=NP.
interpretation.direct_failure: Failure to find such a carrier is not evidence that P!=NP.
